description: On the K2 set, in one rotation, the 60 labelled calibration items score always-B (closed book), always-K (two retrieved passages), the K cascade (K answers twice; the item goes to KS when the two parsed answers differ under normalized-answer-v1, otherwise the first K answer stands) and always-KS by mean token-F1. The highest score wins; scores within equal_within count as equal, and a tie goes to the more thorough candidate, the later one in the list. The choice is emitted as a rule of the closed router grammar.
